title: Native and CuTe route admission omitted the owners of explicit storage, scalar, cache and state contracts

evidence.note: Independent source probe: a valid global FP32 128x64 arithmetic operand with explicit DIMENSION AccessMap was admitted, but row-owned emission read b10[col] and ignored the row address.
Independent source probe: an exported replicated register vector was stored by all 128 epilogue threads and by multiple CTAs.
Separate independent probe isolates CTA ownership: a row-owned 128x64 result has a DIMENSION-only output map, so a 4x4 grid writes the same output tile.
Independent source probe: reuse=streamed was admitted although the generated load body was unchanged and emitted no cache policy.
Independent source probe: a finite Python scalar 1e300 emitted 1e+300f outside the finite FP32 range. Integer scalar canonicalization and keyword entrypoint suffix probes passed and are not defects.

204 source-owner tests: one failure showed CuTe no-MMA dispatch bypassed CUTE_STATE_UNSUPPORTED; unrelated dtype/operation rules blocked instead. One prior Metal fixture skip remains separately recorded.

45 local source tests passed after repairs: 44 native tests plus the CuTe state diagnostic regression. Public and direct emission probes verify the intended guards; vector-thread and CTA hazards are isolated. No device/compiler toolchain was invoked.

First canonical successor preparation refused native-argmin-domain-drift because an invalid producer domain also produced a downstream store warning. Preserve this failure; the producer domain rule owns unavailable argmin results and downstream ownership analysis only examines valid results.

observation: Structural dispatch and row-owned native emission had narrower semantics than their preflight admission. Native arithmetic did not consume global AccessMaps, replicated vectors lacked a unique writing thread, stores could omit varying CTA coordinates, large scalar literals exceeded FP32, and streamed load hints had no emitted effect. CuTe remained blocked on state but lost its explicit state-owner diagnostic. These are source admission defects found by local public-boundary probes, not observed device failures. The named Executor is context only and was not invoked.
proposed_change: Keep native arithmetic in FP32 registers with explicit loads; bound scalar literals to finite FP32; require row-owned stores and all varying ProgramMap coordinates; refuse unimplemented load cache/reuse hints. Keep CuTe state refusal before route dispatch. Each counterexample must be refused by its own backend rule in public assessment and direct emission. Do not widen the IR or add a kernel-specific route.
verification_plan: Bug tick: after exact independent approval and cycle-derived Compiler release, replay the retained JSON probes through the released public Compiler and direct backend boundary, confirm owning diagnostic classes and preserve GEMM/KMeans/multi-MMA positives. Full Corpus Gate must retain all 124 prior expectations and the 21 imported native expectations. New CuTe/native capability compilation, GPU correctness, timing, profiler and framework qualification remain separate and pending.
experience_disposition: Verifier/backend boundary repair only; no compiler transformation, performance tactic or capability qualification is promoted.
